# Growth Modifier Correction Requirements Quality Checklist: End-to-End In-Game Verification (Gate 3)

**Purpose**: Validate that the growth modifier correction requirements (multiplicative math, DayEnding event, host guard, idempotency, all-location scope) are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable — testing the correction specification itself, not whether the correction works.
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. Items test whether correction requirements are well-written, not whether the correction is implemented.
